ruleDefinitions.name: Potential AutoLogger Sessions Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tampering with autologger trace sessions which is a technique used by attackers to disable logging Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\WMI\\\\Autologger\\\\.*") AND ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\EventLog\\-.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Defender.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Enable$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Start$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")) AND  NOT (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\wevtutil\.exe")
